name: sre-agent
description: Agentic SRE orchestrator: environment discovery, parallel evidence collection (Kubernetes, Prometheus, Loki/Elasticsearch, Tempo/Jaeger traces, service mesh, recent changes), root-cause analysis, approval-gated remediation and k6 load validation, and incident reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate and resolve operational incidents safely
interface.longDescription: Use SRE Agent to investigate operational incidents: it discovers the environment and available tooling, collects evidence from Kubernetes, Prometheus, logs, and recent changes, ranks root-cause hypotheses, proposes remediation options with rollback plans, applies fixes only after explicit approval, validates the result, and produces a final incident report.
defaultPrompt: Use sre-agent to investigate why my pods are crash-looping.
Use sre-agent to find out why application latency spiked.
Use sre-agent to debug missing application metrics.
